sections.name: DRIVES
sections.target:
df -TP | awk 'NR==1{next} {printf "Filesystem: %s
Type: %s
1K-blocks: %s
Available: %s
Use%%: %s
Mounted: %s
Size_MB: %.2f
Avail_MB: %.2f
---
", $1, $2, $3, $5, $6, $7, $3/1024, $5/1024}'

sections.name: TEAM VIEWER
sections.target: sudo teamviewer info | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -E "TeamViewer ID|^\s+TeamViewer\s+[0-9]"

sections.name: BIOS
sections.target: dmidecode

sections.name: CONTROLLERS
sections.target: lspci -nnvmm

sections.name: CPUS
sections.target: LANG=C lscpu && dmidecode -t processor

sections.name: INPUTS
sections.target: awk -v RS='' '{ if(match($0,/Bus=[0-9a-fA-F]+/)){ bus_val=substr($0,RSTART,RLENGTH); sub(/Bus=/,"",bus_val); }else{ bus_val=""; } if(match($0,/Vendor=[0-9a-fA-F]+/)){ vendor_val=substr($0,RSTART,RLENGTH); sub(/Vendor=/,"",vendor_val); }else{ vendor_val=""; } if(match($0,/Product=[0-9a-fA-F]+/)){ product_val=substr($0,RSTART,RLENGTH); sub(/Product=/,"",product_val); }else{ product_val=""; } if(match($0,/Name="[^"]+"/)){ name_val=substr($0,RSTART,RLENGTH); sub(/Name="/,"",name_val); sub(/"$/,"",name_val); }else{ name_val=""; } if(match($0,/Sysfs=[^ \n]+/)){ sysfs_val=substr($0,RSTART,RLENGTH); sub(/Sysfs=/,"",sysfs_val); }else{ sysfs_val=""; } b_clean=toupper(bus_val); sub(/^0+/,"",b_clean); if(b_clean=="")b_clean="0"; bus_hex=(length(b_clean)==1?"0x0" b_clean:"0x" b_clean); bus=(bus_hex=="0x01")?"PCI":(bus_hex=="0x02")?"ISAPNP":(bus_hex=="0x03")?"USB":(bus_hex=="0x04")?"HIL":(bus_hex=="0x05")?"Bluetooth":(bus_hex=="0x06")?"Virtual":(bus_hex=="0x10")?"ISA":(bus_hex=="0x11")?"i8042":(bus_hex=="0x12")?"XT Keyboard":(bus_hex=="0x13")?"RS232":(bus_hex=="0x14")?"Gameport":(bus_hex=="0x15")?"Parallel Port":(bus_hex=="0x16")?"Amiga":(bus_hex=="0x17")?"ADB (Apple Desktop Bus)":(bus_hex=="0x18")?"I2C":(bus_hex=="0x19")?"Host":(bus_hex=="0x1A")?"GSC":(bus_hex=="0x1B")?"Atari":(bus_hex=="0x1C")?"SPI":(bus_hex=="0x1D")?"RMI":(bus_hex=="0x1E")?"CEC":(bus_hex=="0x1F")?"Intel ISHTP":(bus_hex=="0x20")?"AMD SFH":"Unknown (" bus_hex ")"; print "Type: " bus; print "Bus: " bus_val; vendor=tolower(vendor_val); print "Vendor: " vendor; product=tolower(product_val); print "Product: " product; if(vendor!=""){ cmd="cat /usr/share/hwdata/usb.ids /var/lib/usbutils/usb.ids /usr/share/misc/usb.ids 2>/dev/null | grep -i \x27^" vendor " \x27 | head -n1 | cut -c7-"; manufacturer=""; cmd | getline manufacturer; close(cmd); print "Manufacturer: " manufacturer; if(product!=""){ cmd2="cat /usr/share/hwdata/usb.ids /var/lib/usbutils/usb.ids /usr/share/misc/usb.ids 2>/dev/null | awk \x27/^" vendor " /{flag=1; next} /^[^[:space:]]/{flag=0} flag && /^[[:space:]]+" product " /{print substr($0, index($0, \x27" product "\x27) + 5); exit}\x27"; description=""; cmd2 | getline description; close(cmd2); print "Description: " description; } if(name_val!="")print "Caption: " name_val; if(sysfs_val!="")print "Interface: " sysfs_val; print "---"; } }' /proc/bus/input/devices

sections.name: LOCAL USERS
sections.target: cat /etc/passwd

sections.name: MEMORIES
sections.target: dmidecode -t 17 -q

sections.name: MONITORS
sections.target:
for f in /sys/class/drm/*/edid; do [ "$(cat "${f%/*}/status" 2>/dev/null)" = "connected" ] || continue; echo -e "
$f
"; vc=$(di-edid-decode "$f" 2>/dev/null | awk '/Manufacturer:/ {print $2}'); [ -n "$vc" ] && echo "Vendor: $(grep -m 1 "^$vc" /usr/share/hwdata/pnp.ids 2>/dev/null | cut -f2- || echo "$vc")"; di-edid-decode "$f"; echo "
==="; done

fields.name: SERIAL NUMBER
fields.retrieval_value: (?:Display Product Serial Number:\s*'|Serial Number:\s*(?![\s\S]*Display Product Serial Number))([^'\s]+)

sections.name: NETWORKS
sections.target: for dev_path in /sys/class/net/*; do dev="${dev_path##*/}"; [[ -d "/sys/class/net/$dev/wireless" ]] && type="wifi" || { [[ "$dev" == lo ]] && type="loopback" || type="ethernet"; }; speed_raw=$(cat "/sys/class/net/$dev/speed" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); mtu=$(cat "/sys/class/net/$dev/mtu" 2>/dev/null); mac_addr=$(cat "/sys/class/net/$dev/address" 2>/dev/null); state=$(cat "/sys/class/net/$dev/operstate" 2>/dev/null); gw=$(ip route show default 2>/dev/null | grep "dev $dev" | awk '{print $3}'); gw6=$(ip -6 route show default 2>/dev/null | grep "dev $dev" | awk '{print $3}'); ip4_cidrs=$(ip -4 -o addr show dev "$dev" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}'); [[ -z "$ip4_cidrs" ]] && ip4_cidrs=" "; for ip4_cidr in $ip4_cidrs; do echo "Description: $dev"; echo "Type: $type"; if [[ "$speed_raw" == "-1" ]]; then echo "Speed: -1"; elif [[ "$speed_raw" -ge 1000 ]]; then echo "Speed: $((speed_raw / 1000)) Gbps"; else echo "Speed: ${speed_raw} Mbps"; fi; echo "MTU: $mtu"; echo "MACAddress: $mac_addr"; echo "Status: $state"; ip="${ip4_cidr%%/*}"; prefix="${ip4_cidr#*/}"; [[ "$ip" == "$prefix" ]] && prefix=""; echo "IPAddress: $ip"; if [[ -n "$prefix" && "$prefix" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then mask=$(( 0xFFFFFFFF << (32 - prefix) & 0xFFFFFFFF )); netmask="$(( (mask >> 24) & 0xFF )).$(( (mask >> 16) & 0xFF )).$(( (mask >> 8) & 0xFF )).$(( mask & 0xFF ))"; echo "Netmask: $netmask"; fi; echo "Gateway: $gw"; if [[ -n "$ip" && -n "$prefix" && "$prefix" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then IFS='.' read -r i1 i2 i3 i4 <<< "$ip"; ip_bin=$(( (i1 << 24) + (i2 << 16) + (i3 << 8) + i4 )); mask_bin=$(( 0xFFFFFFFF << (32 - prefix) & 0xFFFFFFFF )); net_bin=$(( ip_bin & mask_bin )); net_ip=$(printf "%d.%d.%d.%d" $(( (net_bin >> 24) & 0xFF )) $(( (net_bin >> 16) & 0xFF )) $(( (net_bin >> 8) & 0xFF )) $(( net_bin & 0xFF ))); echo "NetworkNumber: $net_ip"; else echo "NetworkNumber: "; fi; echo "---"; done; ip6_cidrs=$(ip -6 -o addr show dev "$dev" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}'); if [[ -n "$ip6_cidrs" ]]; then for ip6_cidr in $ip6_cidrs; do ip6="${ip6_cidr%%/*}"; prefix6="${ip6_cidr#*/}"; if [[ "$prefix6" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then mask6=$(printf '%s\n' $(for i in {0..7}; do bits=$(( (prefix6-16*i)>16 ? 16 : (prefix6-16*i>0 ? prefix6-16*i : 0) )); printf '%04x:' $(( ((1<<bits)-1) << (16-bits) )); done) | sed 's/:$//' | sed -E ':a;s/(^|:)0{1,4}(:0{1,4}){1,}/::/;ta'); else mask6=""; fi; ip6_network=$(ip -6 route show dev "$dev" 2>/dev/null | head -n1 | awk '{print $1}'); echo "Description: $dev"; echo "Type: $type"; if [[ "$speed_raw" == "-1" ]]; then echo "Speed: -1"; elif [[ "$speed_raw" -ge 1000 ]]; then echo "Speed: $((speed_raw / 1000)) Gbps"; else echo "Speed: ${speed_raw} Mbps"; fi; echo "MTU: $mtu"; echo "MACAddress: $mac_addr"; echo "Status: $state"; echo "IPAddress: $ip6"; echo "Netmask: $mask6"; echo "Gateway: $gw6"; echo "NetworkNumber: $ip6_network"; echo "---"; done; fi; done

sections.name: PORTS
sections.target: dmidecode -t connector

sections.name: PRINTERS
sections.target: for name in $(lpstat -p 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}'); do description=$(lpstat -l -p "$name" | grep "Description" | cut -d: -f2- | sed 's/^ *//'); port=$(lpstat -v "$name" | awk -F': ' '{print $2}'); driver=$(lpoptions -p "$name" | grep "printer-make-and-model" | cut -d"'" -f2); echo "Name: $name"; echo "Description: $description"; echo "Port: $port"; echo "Driver: $driver"; echo "---"; done

sections.name: SLOTS
sections.target: dmidecode -t slot

sections.name: SOUNDS
sections.target: lspci -nn | grep -i audio | cut -d ' ' -f1 | xargs -I{} lspci -vmm -s {}

sections.name: STORAGES
sections.target: for storage in $(lsblk -dno NAME,TYPE | awk '$2=="disk"{print $1}'); do echo "Name: $storage"; read type size rota tran < <(lsblk -dnro TYPE,SIZE,ROTA,TRAN "/dev/$storage"); rota_int=$(echo "$rota" | tr -d "[:space:]"); description="$([ $rota_int -eq 0 ] && echo SSD || echo HDD) - $tran"; echo -e "Type: $type\nDiskSize: $size\nDescription: $description"; smartctl_info=$(smartctl -i "/dev/$storage" 2>/dev/null); echo "$smartctl_info" | grep -E "Model Number|Serial Number|Firmware Version" | sed -e 's/Model Number:/Model:/' -e 's/Serial Number:/SerialNumber:/' -e 's/Firmware Version:/Firmware:/'; pci_line=$(echo "$smartctl_info" | grep "PCI Vendor/Subsystem ID"); if [[ -n "$pci_line" ]]; then pci_id=$(echo "$pci_line" | grep -Po '0x[0-9a-fA-F]+'); vendor_id=${pci_id#0x}; if [[ -f /usr/share/hwdata/pci.ids ]]; then manufacturer=$(grep -i "^$vendor_id " /usr/share/hwdata/pci.ids | head -n1 | cut -f2- -d' '); echo "Manufacturer: $manufacturer"; fi; fi; echo "---"; done

sections.name: USB DEVICES
sections.target: lsusb -v

sections.name: VIDEOS
sections.target: videos=($(lspci | grep -iE 'graphics|vga|video|display' | cut -d ' ' -f1)); for slot in "${videos[@]}"; do info=$(lspci -vmm -s "$slot"); chipset=$(echo "$info" | grep '^Class:' | cut -f2-); vendor=$(echo "$info" | grep '^Vendor:' | cut -f2-); device=$(echo "$info" | grep '^Device:' | cut -f2-); name="$vendor $device"; memory=0; while IFS= read -r line; do if [[ $line =~ Memory.*\(.*-bit,\ prefetchable\)\ \[size=([0-9]+)([GMK])\] ]]; then size=${BASH_REMATCH[1]}; unit=${BASH_REMATCH[2]}; case $unit in G) bytes=$(( size * 1024 * 1024 * 1024 )) ;; M) bytes=$(( size * 1024 * 1024 )) ;; K) bytes=$(( size * 1024 )) ;; esac; memory=$(( memory + bytes )); fi; done < <(lspci -v -s "$slot" 2>/dev/null); memory_mb=$(( (memory + 524288) / 1048576 )); echo "Chipset: $chipset"; echo "Name: $name"; echo "Memory: ${memory_mb} MB"; echo "---"; done

sections.name: LOCAL GROUPS
sections.target: cat /etc/group

sections.name: REPOSITORY
sections.target: for repo in $(pacman-conf --repo-list); do echo "$(pacman-conf --repo="$repo" Server | head -n 1) $(pacman-conf Architecture)/$repo"; done

sections.name: SOFTWARES
sections.target:
LC_ALL=C pacman -Qi | awk 'function val() { v = $0; sub(/^[^:]*: /, "", v); gsub(/-{3,}/, "--", v); return v == "None" ? "" : v } function flush() { if (name == "") return; printf("Name: %s
Publisher: %s
Version: %s
Comments: %s
FileSize: %d
InstallDate: %s
From: pacman
Architecture: %s
", name, publisher, version, comments, size, date, arch); raw = version; sub(/^[0-9]+:/, "", raw); if (match(raw, /^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)*/)) { n = split(substr(raw, RSTART, RLENGTH), parts, "."); printf("Major: %s
", parts[1]); if (n > 1) printf("Minor: %s
", parts[2]); if (n > 2) printf("Patch: %s
", parts[3]) } printf("---
"); name = "" } /^Name +:/ { flush(); name = val(); publisher = version = comments = date = arch = ""; size = 0 } /^Version +:/ { version = val() } /^Description +:/ { comments = val() } /^Architecture +:/ { arch = val() } /^URL +:/ { publisher = val() } /^Installed Size +:/ { split(val(), s, " "); size = s[1] * (s[2] == "KiB" ? 1024 : s[2] == "MiB" ? 1048576 : s[2] == "GiB" ? 1073741824 : s[2] == "TiB" ? 1099511627776 : 1) } /^Install Date +:/ { split(val(), d, " "); date = sprintf("%s-%02d-%02d %s", d[5], (index("JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec", d[2]) + 2) / 3, d[3], d[4]) } END { flush() }'

sections.name: BATTERIES
sections.target: upower -i $(upower -e | grep BAT)

sections.name: FIREWALL RULES
sections.target: sudo bash -c 'for bin in iptables ip6tables; do ver=$([ "$bin" = "iptables" ] && echo "IPv4" || echo "IPv6"); for chain in INPUT OUTPUT FORWARD; do while IFS= read -r line; do line=$(echo "$line" | sed "s/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//"); [ -z "$line" ] && continue; read -r pkts bytes action proto opt in_if out_if source dest rest <<< "$line"; [ -z "$dest" ] && continue; [[ "${source,,}" == "source" ]] && continue; case $(echo "$proto" | tr -cd "0-9") in 1) p="ICMP";; 6) p="TCP";; 17) p="UDP";; 58) p="IPv6-ICMP";; *) p="$proto";; esac; comment=$(echo "$rest" | grep -oP "(?<=/\* ).*?(?= \*/)"); dst_port=$(echo "$rest" | grep -oP "dpts?:\K[\d:]+"); src_port=$(echo "$rest" | grep -oP "spts?:\K[\d:]+"); other=$(echo "$rest" | sed "s|/\*.*\*\/||g;s/dpts\?:[0-9:]* //g;s/spts\?:[0-9:]* //g;s/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//"); [ "$in_if" != "*" ] && [ -n "$in_if" ] && other="in=$in_if $other"; [ "$out_if" != "*" ] && [ -n "$out_if" ] && other="$other out=$out_if"; echo "DIRECTION=$chain SOURCE=$source SOURCE_PORT=$src_port DESTINATION=$dest DESTINATION_PORT=$dst_port ACTION=$action PROTOCOL=$p COMMENT=$comment OTHER=$other"; done < <($bin -L $chain -n -v 2>/dev/null | tail -n +3); done; done'

sections.name: UPTIME
sections.target: python3 -c "import subprocess,datetime;u=open('/proc/uptime').read().split()[0];s=int(float(u));d=s//86400;h=(s%86400)//3600;m=(s%3600)//60;boot=subprocess.check_output('uptime -s',shell=True).decode().strip();print(f'DURATION={d:02d} days {h:02d} hours {m:02d} minutes\nLOG_DATE={boot}')"

sections.name: SECURITY CERTIFICATE
sections.target: for f in /etc/ssl/certs/*.pem /etc/ssl/certs/*.crt; do [ -f "$f" ] && echo "NAME=$(basename $f) AUTHORITY=$(openssl x509 -in $f -noout -issuer 2>/dev/null | sed 's/issuer=//') DATESTART=$(openssl x509 -in $f -noout -startdate 2>/dev/null | sed 's/notBefore=//') EXPIRATION=$(openssl x509 -in $f -noout -enddate 2>/dev/null | sed 's/notAfter=//') "; done

sections.name: CRON TAB TASKS
sections.target: grep -rH --include="*" -E "^[^#]" /etc/cron.d/ /etc/crontab /var/spool/cron/ 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^$" | while read line; do echo "$line" | python3 -c "import sys; p,_,l=sys.stdin.read().strip().partition(':'); f=l.split(); is_sys=not p.startswith('/var/spool/cron/'); m,h,dom,month,dow=(f[0],f[1],f[2],f[3],f[4]) if len(f)>=5 else ('','','','',''); user=(f[5] if len(f)>5 else '') if is_sys else p.split('/')[-1]; cmd=' '.join(f[6:]) if is_sys and len(f)>6 else ' '.join(f[5:]) if len(f)>5 else ''; print(f'MINUTE={m} HOUR={h} DOM={dom} MONTH={month} DOW={dow} USER={user} CRON={cmd}') if len(f)>=5 else None"; done

sections.name: RUNNING PROCESS
sections.target: LC_ALL=C ps -eo user=,pid=,pcpu=,pmem=,vsz=,tty=,lstart=,args= | python3 -c "import sys,datetime; [print('USERNAME='+f[0]+' PROCESSID='+f[1]+' CPUUSAGE='+f[2]+' PROCESSMEMORY='+f[3]+' VIRTUALMEMORY='+f[4]+' TTY='+f[5]+' STARTED='+datetime.datetime.strptime(' '.join(f[7:11]),'%b %d %H:%M:%S %Y').strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')+' COMMANDLINE='+' '.join(f[11:])) for line in sys.stdin for f in [line.split()] if len(f)>=12]"

sections.name: VIRTUAL MACHINES
sections.target: (for u in $(cut -d: -f1 /etc/passwd); do sudo -u $u bash -c 'VBoxManage list vms; virsh --connect qemu:///session list --all --name'; done; virsh --connect qemu:///system list --all --name) 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^$'
